lead: A `dossier.py --verify` check's failure detail is its *stderr*, which is the release-binary notice, while the reason it failed is on stdout.
body: The acceptance report for goal `lang-iteration` read `exit 1 -- dossier: target/release/nvs.exe is missing or older than the tree`, which is a line `current_binary` prints before it builds that binary itself; the real reason was the gate line saying three features owed every proof. Run the check's own argv and read stdout — `dossier gate:` names what is owed — rather than rebuilding anything by hand.
